Original Issue: Join Discord Server button was an inert <button> with no onClick, href, or navigation link
Social links (GitHub, Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook) defaulted to dead href='#' when database links were absent
Mock project items used liveUrl: '#' resulting in non-functional demo buttons
Remediation Applied: Cleaned fallback mock data and conditionally rendered 'Live Demo' buttons only when valid URL exists

Original Issue: Share and verification links used window.location.origin which resolves to http://localhost:3000 locally
Preview canvas submit button was disabled with no tooltip or user feedback
Remediation Applied: Added explanatory tooltip clarifying preview mode

Original Issue: Demo role switcher modal allowed unauthenticated escalation to super_admin and hr in production builds
Remediation Applied: Gated modal trigger strictly behind import.meta.env.DEV and added runtime role escalation rejection guard

Original Issue: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY was embedded in client bundle and sent via query string in browser requests
Remediation Applied: Created secure serverless endpoint /api/ai/chat proxying Gemini calls server-side

Component: Admin Session Hijacking on User Ops
Original Issue: Admin user creation/deletion via client Supabase client swapped admin session with new user
Remediation Applied: Created serverless endpoint /api/admin/users with service_role and isolated client with persistSession: false

Original Issue: Missing canonical link and description meta in HTML shell
Remediation Applied: Added <link rel='canonical'> and meta description for https://datacamp-student-club.vercel.app/

Original Issue: HTML5 browser validation prevented display of cyberpunk error banners on invalid email
Remediation Applied: Added noValidate to form elements enabling custom styled validation errors
